Ishwardi Export Processing Zone (Ishwardi EPZ) is a specialised Export Processing Zone (EPZ) located in Pakshi, Pabna District, Bangladesh. It was established in 2001 and operates under the management of the Bangladesh Export Processing Zone Authority (BEPZA). The zone is strategically located near key transportation hubs, making it an attractive destination for investors. It is the third biggest economic zone in Bangladesh.
Amenities provided
It is a duty-free area where raw materials can be imported completely duty-free: the products can be exported abroad completely duty-free. There is an 11 KV sub-station for water supply system and electricity through BEPZA authority for supply to industrial establishments; It is also used as a fuel through the Western Region Gas Authority.
Export
Over the past six years, BEPZA has achieved a 129.55% growth in investment, 155.95% in exports, and 112.30% in employment.
Location
Ishwardi EPZ is situated in Pakshi, Pabna, with convenient access to major infrastructure
* 10.60 km from Ishwardi Airport
* 130 km from Bangabandhu Bridge
* 220 km from Dhaka
* 280 km from Mongla Port
* 484 km from Chittagong Port
Profile of the Zone
* Total Area: 309 acres
* Number of Industrial Plots: 324 (average size: 2000 sqm each)
* Standard Factory Buildings (SFB): 64,576.00 sqm (total)
* Tariff for Plots: US $1.40 per sqm per year
* Tariff for SFBs: US $1.75 per sqm per month
Utility Services
Ishwardi EPZ provides various utility services to support industrial operations:
* Water Supply: Managed by the zone's own water supply system.
* Gas Supply: Provided by Pashchimanchal Gas Company Ltd.
* Power Supply: Available through the zone's own sub-station (11kV, 3-phase, 50 cycles/sec).
